ReportQueryDefinition.Name: Реестр входящей корреспонденции — проекция 1С:Документооборот
ReportQueryDefinition.Command: SELECT m.incoming_number AS reg_number, m.date_created AS reg_date, c.name AS correspondent, c.inn AS correspondent_inn, m.to_str1 AS subject, m.note AS summary, m.status AS doc_state FROM mails m JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id WHERE CAST(m.date_created AS DATE) = CAST(:Date AS DATE) AND m.incoming_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.incoming_number ASC;

SELECT m.incoming_number AS reg_number, m.date_created AS reg_date, c.name AS correspondent, c.inn AS correspondent_inn, m.to_str1 AS subject, m.note AS summary, m.status AS doc_state FROM mails m JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id WHERE date(m.date_created) = date(:Date) AND m.incoming_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.incoming_number ASC;
